phases.title: Pipeline empty-state hint
phases.desired_end_state: When 'Actively working' is empty, show a quiet one-line hint instead of self-hiding. GUINEA-PIG for the first live P4 closeout dogfood — promote this through the board to Launch. Spec: agents/beacon/specs/projects-v3-pipeline-empty-state.md (repo ourliberty-dashboard).

closeout.summary: The projects board now greets an empty 'Actively working' area with a quiet one-line nudge telling people how to start, instead of showing nothing. This was also our first real test of the automatic phase-closeout, so the next phase can lean on that closeout flow with more confidence.
closeout.shipped: When no projects are active, the board shows the 'Actively working' heading plus a single faint line: 'Nothing here yet — Promote an item from the funnel to start a project.' When projects are active, the board looks exactly as it did before. Delivered in PR #66.
closeout.changed_vs_spec: It matched the plan — a subtle, single muted line with no new buttons, cards, or colors, and the populated view left untouched. One caveat: the automated tests couldn't be run in the build environment, so the test pass was left to be confirmed in CI.
closeout.learnings: This phase was deliberately small and easily reversible so it could prove out the build-to-done closeout process before a bigger feature relies on it. The live board checks — empty-state hint, unchanged populated view, and the completion handoff — still need a real eyes-on confirmation since they can't be verified automatically.

phases.title: Capitalize the mission-action PR-open label
phases.desired_end_state: On the Missions board, when an action (Defer/Resume/Reprioritize) has an open PR, the status line shows the action capitalized ('Defer PR open') instead of lowercase. One-line dashboard papercut — the vehicle for the live P3/P4 board-Launch dogfood.

closeout.summary: The Missions board now shows action names like 'Defer PR open' properly capitalized instead of lowercase. This small polish item is done and merged (PR #70); the next phase can build on the cleaned-up board without revisiting this.
closeout.shipped: A display-only fix so that when a mission action (Defer, Resume, Reprioritize) has an open pull request, the status line reads with a capital first letter — 'Defer PR open' instead of 'defer PR open'.
closeout.changed_vs_spec: It followed the plan exactly. The fix was display-only with no change to the underlying action values or buttons, and a test was added confirming the capitalized line renders.
closeout.learnings: Nothing new of note — this was a one-line grammar papercut that landed cleanly. It served its larger purpose as a small live exercise of the board-launch dogfood workflow.

phases.title: P5 — DAG status on cards
phases.desired_end_state: Glanceable live build status on pipeline phase cards (step N/M · actor · last event), early ⚠ stuck badge, project N-of-M rollup, click-through to Build Sequences. Dashboard-only. Spec: agents/beacon/specs/projects-v3-p5-dag-status.md (repo ourliberty-dashboard). Launch through the board to also confirm the P4 enriched completion DM.

closeout.summary: The Projects tab now shows live build status right on each phase card, so you can see what's running, stuck, or done without leaving the page. The next phase can build on this glanceable pipeline view; it also served as the first real-world test of the enriched 'phase done' notification.
closeout.shipped: Phase cards that are building now show a compact live line (which step it's on, who's working it, and the latest activity), an early warning badge when a build looks stuck, a 'how many phases done out of total' rollup at the project level, and a click-through to the full build detail. Delivered in PR #71.
closeout.changed_vs_spec: It landed as planned with no new backend work, no new alerts, and no extra polling — it reuses the same live feed the Operations tab already shows. The stuck badge is purely a visual heads-up on the card and does not send any messages; the real stuck-alert notifications stay where they already were.
closeout.learnings: The existing live build feed was reusable as-is, so this was assembly rather than new plumbing. One open item: the browser walk-through (live status, rollup, stuck badge, click-through, and confirming the 'phase done' notification) had to be verified on the live board, not in the build sandbox.
